name: Optimized Qwen 3 Chat Template

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Qwen 3 chat template rendering closure that encloses all message serialization and tool invocation formatting within a single deterministic output string.

VINIT.justification: The void before any template variable is evaluated, where messages and tools lists are absent from the output buffer.

TANCH.justification: The terminal anchor is the add_generation_prompt closure that seals the rendered sequence with the assistant start marker, containing the whole system.

AFWD.justification: Forward morphism from void to structured output by writing the system role block and tool definitions toward the generation prompt.

AREV.justification: Reverse morphism traversing messages in reversed order to locate the last user query index, a descent through the array.

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition chaining each message role block (user, assistant, tool) into the contiguous output stream.

IMSCRIB.justification: The template references its own structure via namespace and loop constructs, recognizing itself as the rendering grammar.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits the rendering path into two arms: arm T when tools list exists (emit tool schema block), arm F when absent (skip tool block). Input is the raw messages plus tools context.

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the original rendering context after the tools branch by continuing the message loop, recovering the full serialization task exactly.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation: tools variable is non-empty, tool XML block is emitted successfully.

EVALF.justification: Negative evaluation: tools variable absent, system block emitted without tool schema.

ENGAGR.justification: Paradice held when assistant message contains both reasoning_content and content simultaneously, both emitted without resolution of which is primary.

IFIX.justification: Permanent append-only record of the <|im_end|> delimiter closing each turn, cannot be undone in the output buffer.

phase_3.void_description: Uninitialized render buffer with no messages parsed and no template execution begun.
phase_3.true_description: Affirmative state where a branch condition holds and the corresponding block is emitted correctly.
phase_3.false_description: Negative state where a branch condition fails and the skipped block is absent from output.
phase_3.both_description: Paradice where assistant reasoning and final content are both present and serialized in one block without collapse.

steps.domain_action: establish unrendered_prompt_state as the void before template execution
template references its own loop and namespace grammar as identity
branch on tools presence, input is raw_messages_and_tools_context
tools list non-empty, affirm tool schema emission arm
emit system block and tool XML definitions toward output
tools absent, negative arm skips tool schema
reverse scan messages to find last_query_index
reunite arms into unified_render_resume recovering full context
chain role blocks sequentially for each message in order
assistant message holds both reasoning and content in one emission
write <|im_end|> delimiter as permanent turn closure
add_generation_prompt seals output with assistant start marker

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Jinja2 template engine that translates the chat template syntax into rendered string operations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: String concatenation buffer shared across template blocks via the output stream
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Namespace object ns and loop variables holding indices and multi_step_tool flag
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Template loop iterator that determines message traversal order and branch execution
phase_5.alfs_store: Qwen 3 model card and chat template source defining the canonical rendering contract

phase_6.cycle_cost: CPU cycles and buffer allocation per rendered token
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Unrendered message list and empty output buffer
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Fully serialized prompt string with all roles and tools formatted
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the template is deterministic and reversible in structure, consuming fixed resources per token without net disorder increase
